title: Low HDL-C and carotid thickness
text: Question: Do mutations causing low HDL-C promote increased carotid intima-media thickness? Answer: no. Genetic variants identified in the present study may be insufficient to promote early carotid atherosclerosis.

title: Short stay pediatric ward effectiveness
text: Question: A short stay or 23-hour ward in a general and academic children's hospital: are they effective? Answer: yes. The evidence suggests that short stay wards can improve efficient patient care in a cost-effective way while maintaining parental satisfaction.

title: PubMedQA biomedical question answering
text: PubMedQA is a biomedical question answering dataset built from PubMed abstracts. Questions are commonly evaluated using yes, no, or maybe labels together with longer evidence-based explanations.

title: Self-RAG for biomedical evidence grounding
text: Self-RAG can be adapted for biomedical question answering by retrieving domain passages, generating an answer, and using reflection tokens to judge relevance, support, and utility.
